mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte wasting, which may impair ampicillin renal clearance and increase ampicillin concentrations; both agents can cause hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (particularly potassium and magnesium), and ampicillin levels closely; consider dosage adjustments based on creatinine clearance; ensure adequate hydration and electrolyte supplementation.
